title: slot_map end-to-end absent: no beacon writer sets it; C/Rust enforce single slot not slot_map (spec 02a 2a.2)
description: Requirements: R-02a-013 (MUST): 'The root MUST set slot_map on each beacon' — not-implemented, no beacon writer sets slot_map in any language (Rust parse-only rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs:186-268; Python validates only python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py:63-96). R-02a-014 (MUST): 'Joiners MUST adopt the assigned slot_map and MUST NOT transmit outside it' — divergent: slot_map-granular TX gating is Python-only (slot_coordination.py:99-121 tx_allowed, tests python/tests/link/test_slot_coordination.py); C lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c:161-196 (tdma_tx_allowed) and Rust lichen-link/src/tdma_clock.rs enforce a single hash-derived slot, not a slot_map. R-02a-012 (receivers MUST validate entries < num_slots): implemented+tested Python/Rust (ccp_slot_map_validation.json 15 vectors), missing in C. Suggested placement: add slot_map to the C/Rust TDMA admission path (tdma_tx_allowed / tdma_clock::tx_allowed) consuming the parsed beacon slot_map; add a root-side beacon builder that emits slot_map; port ccp_slot_map_validation.json consumer to C. From spec-coverage sweep 2026-08-31 (docs/spec-coverage.md R-02a-012/013/014).
